note: General planning dates, not award deadlines. Windows are typical, not guaranteed -- confirm each date with the college or agency for the year in question. Families override or add to these in Settings.

milestones.title: College applications open
milestones.note: The Common App and most college portals open August 1 for students graduating the following spring.

milestones.title: PSAT/NMSQT window
milestones.note: Schools pick a date inside this window. Only the junior-year score qualifies for National Merit.

milestones.title: FAFSA opens
milestones.note: The federal aid form for next school year. The opening date has moved in recent years -- check studentaid.gov before counting on it.

milestones.title: CSS Profile opens
milestones.note: Required by some private colleges on top of the FAFSA. Check whether any school on the list asks for it.

milestones.title: Early action and early decision deadlines
milestones.note: Most EA and ED deadlines fall in this window, November 1 being the common one. Letters and essays have to be done before it, not during.

milestones.title: Early decision II and priority deadlines
milestones.note: A second early round at some colleges, and the priority date for merit consideration at many others.

milestones.title: Regular decision deadlines
milestones.note: January 1 and February 1 are the common ones.

milestones.title: State and college aid priority deadlines
milestones.note: Many states and colleges award their own aid first-come. Filing by March 1 is the usual advice.

milestones.title: Local scholarship season
milestones.note: Community foundations, civic clubs and employer awards cluster in late winter. Small pools, short applications.

milestones.title: College decision day
milestones.note: The usual national deadline to accept an offer and put down a deposit.
